profile.visual_desc: Stocky figure in voluminous navy robes with grey trim. Wears a fabric hood featuring a dark mesh visor. Brown boots and pouches accent the dark attire.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Close-up of a blue fabric mask. Glowing blue eyes shine through a rectangular black mesh visor. Mysterious and stern gaze.
profile.weapon_desc: Large, blunt wooden club-staff gripped in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Stands facing down-right in heavy robes. Staff held vertically at the side in a neutral guard.
profile.step2_windup: Shifts weight forward, tilting the heavy club back to prepare a horizontal sweeping strike.
profile.step3_impact: Lunges forward, swinging the wooden club in a wide horizontal arc. No magical VFX; focus is on the physical momentum of the blunt impact.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the extended follow-through pose. The club remains at the end of its trajectory as the character recovers balance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The strike follows a direct horizontal path consistent with the physical swing of the wooden club-staff.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation matches source windup and strike. Biomechanics and VFX alignment are functional.
